cohort: A total of 10,656 women were included in the 2004 analysis (7.6% residing in the refugee hosting community) and 15,426 women in the 2011 analysis (5.8% residing in the hosting community).
finding: Between 2004 and 2011, the proportion of women delivering outside health facilities and children not completing DPT3 vaccination in the refugee hosting community decreased by 9.0% and 9.6% respectively, while ANC attendance and caesarean delivery did not significantly change.
